title: HyperWorld：超图结构化状态序列化提升文本世界模型学习
summary: HyperWorld研究了文本环境中世界模型的状态序列化结构。对比原始观测和三种符号序列化，发现基于实体的超边序列化在中小模型和分布外场景下效果最佳，能提升可行性检测和效果预测，并在下游规划中取得最高成功率。
summary_en: HyperWorld studies state serialization for textual world models. Comparing raw observations with symbolic serializations, entity-centered hyperedge units yield the best gains for 0.5B-1.5B models and under distribution shift, improving feasibility detection, effect prediction, and downstream planning success.
